findings.title: Do not rotate recipients after an observed proof or reorg failure
findings.reproduction: Actual createCapableWalletReadProvider loads the frozen source; selected wallet returns Sepolia chainId and throws Error(message) carrying status503 for eth_getProof(address,[],{blockHash,requireCanonical:true}). Messages invalid proof and canonical block hash mismatch; reorg detected each dispatch the same payload to managed and return its synthetic alternate success. Revert/access-denial controls reject without managed payload.
findings.expected: Reject and send zero alternate target reads after either semantic proof/reorg failure, regardless of outer retryable HTTP status. Preserve request fields and the original failure.

actual.message: canonical block hash mismatch; reorg detected

findings.relevance: The new connected public-read routing uses this inherited classifier and must meet the explicit no-semantic-failure-rotation boundary. This is not an eth_simulateV1 replay or a claimed live chain incident.

reviewedBoundaries.gateway: Same-origin check and existing creator session precede upstream lookup; shared database quota fails closed. Positive enabled-chain registry determines the sole upstream URL. No caller URL, headers, or credentials accepted.
reviewedBoundaries.admission: Strict public method/parameter allowlist; rejects signing/submission/eth_simulateV1/state-overrides and foreign eth_call/estimate sender. Exact cloned parameters, gas, fees, value, address and block object are retained.
reviewedBoundaries.bounds: Incoming body512KiB, streamed response10MiB,20s physical server read scope,25s browser abort,180requests/minute shared quota. No claim these bounds prove unknown upstream EVM gas capacity.
reviewedBoundaries.identity: Wallet/account checks and selected/managed chain checks surround successful reads; wrong-chain/current-account changes discard results. Request clone precedes asynchronous checks.
reviewedBoundaries.secrets: Only existing server-selected chain RPC is used; generic errors strip upstream URLs/headers/arbitrary messages. No new credentials.
reviewedBoundaries.execution: New managed allowlist excludes eth_simulateV1 and every send/sign method. Selected publication path and physical simulation lock remain on their existing path.
reviewedBoundaries.activity: Only after exact canonical transaction/runtime reconciliation, matching client deployment Activity txHash, chain, route and pending status settle. Unknown-hash, foreign-chain/server/finished/unrelated jobs remain separate.

limits.reviewerFreshCheck: Four-case actual-source synthetic-provider negative harness; fails two required cases and passes denial/revert controls.
limits.initialAttempt: Missing TypeScript at source worktree; retained separate initial-environment log. Corrected dependency boundary uses existing QA node_modules without changing source or assertions.
